text: {"features":[{"evidence":"\"tht makes secure development\"","name":"Typographical accuracy","description":"Captures how mechanically polished and error-free the letter is.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent misspellings or malformed sentences noticeably damage credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors appear, but the overall meaning remains readable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mostly clean writing with only minor slips."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Nearly error-free and professionally polished throughout."}]},{"evidence":"\"The moment that shaped my engineering priorities\"","name":"Opening distinctiveness","description":"Captures how memorable and role-relevant the opening framing is.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Opens generically with little hook beyond applying for the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Opens with a mild statement of interest but remains formulaic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Opens with a clear anecdote, principle, or thesis tied to the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Opens with a memorable, role-relevant frame that strengthens the rest of the letter."}]},{"evidence":"\"software that guards other software must be built to a higher standard\"","name":"Security thesis","description":"Captures whether the letter articulates a substantive point of view about security engineering rather than only stating interest.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No clear point of view about security work is expressed."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States interest in security impact without a real underlying principle."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Articulates a clear security principle such as secure defaults, resilience, or attacker thinking."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses a nuanced security worldview to organize the letter and explain fit."}]},{"evidence":"\"the mandate to embed protections into the development lifecycle itself\"","name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"Captures how clearly the applicant explains why this specific role is a logical next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little reason beyond wanting the job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in security or backend work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains why this role's mandate fits prior work or next-step goals."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes a compelling case that this particular role is the natural continuation of the candidate's trajectory."}]},{"evidence":"\"how Google treats security as an engineering discipline\"","name":"Google tailoring","description":"Captures how specifically the letter is tailored to Google rather than any security employer.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could be sent to almost any software or security employer."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names Google but adds little company-specific substance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"References Google scale, Core, or Google's security culture in a relevant way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows targeted understanding of Google's internal developer ecosystem or operating model."}]},{"evidence":"\"improvements there are inherited by every team downstream\"","name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"Captures preference for foundational work that scales across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focus stays on isolated project work or says nothing about leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gestures at broad impact without much detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly prefers foundational or platform work serving many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames value in terms of inherited improvements, central systems, or fleet-wide impact."}]},{"evidence":"\"make the secure path the easy path for busy product engineers\"","name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"Captures whether security is framed as enabling developers through good defaults and reduced friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Security is framed mainly as control, compliance, or personal interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at helping other engineers but vaguely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly wants to make secure behavior easier for developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong empathy for busy engineering teams and treats friction reduction as a design goal."}]},{"evidence":"\"Bachelor's degree\" \"Master's degree\" \"Doctoral degree\"","name":"Education level","description":"Captures the highest relevant academic credential stated.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience only."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree in a relevant field."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree in a relevant field."}]},{"evidence":"\"3 years\" \"5 years\" \"7 years\"","name":"Relevant experience duration","description":"Captures total years of professional software experience relevant to the posting.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Roughly 2 to 3 years of relevant software experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Roughly 4 to 5 years of relevant software experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"6 or more years of relevant software experience."}]},{"evidence":"\"launch of 2 production services\"","name":"Production service scope","description":"Captures repeated ownership of software tested, maintained, and launched in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions about 2 production services or similarly limited launch history."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions about 4 services or moderate repeated delivery."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions about 6 or more services or extensive repeated launches."}]},{"evidence":"\"alongside 2 other languages\"","name":"Programming language breadth","description":"Captures breadth of multi-language development beyond Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go plus only a small additional set of languages."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Go plus a moderate additional set of languages."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Go plus a wide additional set across many languages."}]},{"evidence":"\"Having reviewed the posting closely, I believe my background aligns directly\"","name":"Qualification mapping clarity","description":"Captures how easy the letter makes it for a reader to verify match against the stated requirements.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The reader must infer major qualifications from scattered statements."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Covers some requirements clearly but leaves important fit areas ambiguous."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes most core qualifications easy to verify."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Systematically maps experience to the posting with very little ambiguity."}]},{"evidence":"\"Python became my workhorse\"","name":"Python depth","description":"Captures the depth and concreteness of Python use relevant to automation, services, or tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful Python use is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python as a secondary tool with little detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for services, automation, or tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production-grade Python ownership with concrete responsibilities or quality markers."}]},{"evidence":"\"built and shipped LLM-based features\"","name":"AI production exposure","description":"Captures whether the applicant has actually built AI-backed functionality in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or limited experimentation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or shipping AI-backed production features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained professional AI work across multiple features, systems, or contexts."}]},{"evidence":"\"evaluation scaffolding required to deploy them responsibly\"","name":"AI reliability discipline","description":"Captures awareness of evaluation, failure modes, and operational controls for AI systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No sign of evaluation or failure-mode awareness."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes only a vague claim that AI was made trustworthy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions evaluation, constraints, hardening, or dependability concerns."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates mature operational thinking about AI through explicit evaluation practices or failure-mode engineering."}]},{"evidence":"\"Python agents\" \"Go services constrain what they may touch\"","name":"Agentic architecture ownership","description":"Captures hands-on design ownership of agent-based systems with clear boundaries and control planes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No agentic system experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents without explaining design responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling with defined Python and Go roles."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows design ownership of bounded autonomy, permissions, auditing, or task decomposition."}]},{"evidence":"\"automated vulnerability report handling\"","name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"Captures direct experience automating intake, triage, routing, or deduplication of security findings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No direct triage automation evidence appears."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in reducing manual security toil without claiming prior ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Built automation for intake, routing, or triage of vulnerability reports."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of classification, deduplication, routing, or measurable workload reduction."}]},{"evidence":"\"conducted formal security assessments\"","name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Captures how substantive the applicant's security review experience is.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No meaningful assessment work is described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions reviews or assessments only in general terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on threat modeling, code review, or formal assessments."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents assessments as rigorous engineering work with attacker perspective, findings, and remediation follow-through."}]},{"evidence":"\"replaced ad-hoc traversals with proper graph algorithms\"","name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"Captures demonstrated command of data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No concrete algorithms or data-structure evidence is given."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strength in algorithms but gives little proof."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one solid concrete example of algorithmic redesign or structure choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives especially crisp or multiple examples showing strong algorithmic judgment."}]},{"evidence":"\"CompTIA Security+\" \"OSCP\"","name":"Security credential strength","description":"Captures the strength of external security validation named in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No external security credential is named."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names a baseline credential such as Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Names a hands-on offensive credential such as OSCP or an equivalent practical exam."}]},{"evidence":"\"placed near the top\"","name":"Capture-the-flag intensity","description":"Captures the seriousness and demonstrated level of offensive practice through CTF participation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No CTF activity is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional or casual participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular participation or consistently strong involvement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Indicates serious competition with near-top or top placements."}]},{"evidence":"\"submit corrective patches\" \"maintain an open-source project\"","name":"Open-source engagement","description":"Captures public software contribution ranging from occasional fixes to sustained maintainership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source work is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or one-off upstream fixes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular contribution or maintainership of an actively used project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained public maintainership with external users, reviews, releases, and community responsibility."}]},{"evidence":"\"distributed job scheduler with leader election and crash recovery\"","name":"Personal project rigor","description":"Captures the ambition and technical depth of self-directed projects described outside the day job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No side project is described, or it is only mentioned in passing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Describes a small utility or simple application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial self-directed build with a clear engineering challenge."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes an ambitious systems project tackling hard distributed or failure-handling problems."}]},{"evidence":"\"queue went from a dreaded chore to something the tooling mostly runs itself\"","name":"Achievement concreteness","description":"Captures whether accomplishments are presented as specific examples with observable outcomes rather than generic claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on abstract claims and adjectives."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specific tasks or tools but little sense of result."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives concrete examples of what was built or changed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete examples plus outcomes, design choices, or why the work mattered."}]},{"evidence":"\"too many signals, too few experts\"","name":"Security automation framing","description":"Captures the sophistication with which the letter frames security work as a scaling and systems problem.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security work generically or not at all as a systems problem."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation as useful but without a strong framing of the problem."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Frames security work in terms of reducing toil, scaling response, or systematizing workflow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames security automation with high sophistication around scarce expert attention, variant analysis, routing, or organization-wide capacity."}]}]}
